lines.text: Mordecai tears his clothes, puts on sackcloth and ashes, and goes only as far as the king's gate.
The Jews in every province fast and weep, and Esther sends clothes to Mordecai, but he will not accept them.
Esther sends Hathach to Mordecai, who tells him how much money Haman promised and gives him a copy of the king's ring.
Esther says anyone approaching the king uninvited is put to death unless he extends the gold scepter, and she has not been summoned for sixty days.
Esther tells Mordecai to gather the Jews in Susa and fast three days, then she will go to the king.
